title: Cyberwave Simulation Runtime Audit
description: What a running simulation plant reports about itself. ready is true only when the reported backend equals the requested backend, the execution profile and feature profile match the workload, the bundle/image digests match, and every required capability is 'ok' (first valid sample received). mismatches lists every reason it is not. See cyberwave_contracts.simulation.check_runtime_audit.

run_id.description: Execution identity of this run; changes on every start.

reported_backend.description: Backend the runtime actually runs. A string, not the enum, so an unexpected value can be reported as a mismatch rather than rejected.

execution_profile.description: Execution profile the runtime actually runs.

engine.description: Engine the runtime actually steps: physx or newton for isaac (see cyberwave_contracts.simulation.EXECUTION_PROFILE_PHYSICS), mujoco for the MuJoCo worker. A string, not an enum, so an unexpected engine is reported as a mismatch rather than rejected.

feature_profile_id.description: profile_id@version of the implemented feature profile.

capabilities.description: Capability (sensor id, modality or state stream) -> status.

error_code.description: Stable error code when not ready, e.g. simulation_backend_runtime_mismatch.
